title_suffix: finer certified endpoints (1e-120) and deeper outer witness on PR1424 (46 bootstrap steps, eta=beta=1e-124, kappa grid 1e-67); construction unchanged
summary: PR1424's construction is unchanged. The certified complex endpoints (native and conservative) are refined from the inherited 1e-24 bracket to 1e-120: the retained engines still certify the 1e-24 bracket, and finer-constant copies of both rational engines certify accept at the endpoint and reject at endpoint+1e-120. The outer witness settings are deepened (bootstrap steps 46, eta = beta = 1e-124, backoff 1e-127, final kappa grid 1e-67) and the decimal fields are exact. kappa moves from 0.001676855229071321886206381217337893 to 0.001676855229071321886206456772274592619512448739510475262803365191.
credits: PR1424, PR1319 and PR1297 (rohanarun: outer witness refinement, 74-replica exact fill, four cold kernels 531/543/555/567); PR1377 finer kappa grid and PR1274 helper-donor kernel (jeremykothe2); PR1286, PR1193 (jeremydiviney), PR1148 (Thomas DiFiore), PR1195/1196 and the retained lineage named in those packages. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
